+	};

+#if defined(__cpp_lib_hardware_interference_size)
+	GODOT_GCC_WARNING_PUSH_AND_IGNORE("-Winterference-size")
+	static constexpr size_t CACHE_LINE_BYTES = std::hardware_destructive_interference_size;

body: Strange, as it appears that some places the `thread.h` is included is not C++17, so `std::hardware_destructive_interference_size` is not defined. This seems bad, as it means the definition of `CACHE_LINE_BYTES` is different.

body:
I ran into this before, see #101004.

That's super weird, but `std::hardware_destructive_interference_size` is defined in `<new>` so depending on whether it's included or not, it can be missing.

So here including `<new>` unconditionally should solve it.

body: Nevermind, just after posting I saw you're including `<new>` already... weird.
I added the ability to specify a platform-specific thread yield, as `test_rid.h` was failing to compile on Apple, due to directly calling `std::this_thread::yield()`.

body: Very! Probably requires a deeper investigation, as the same issue would occur for the default `thread.h` implementation. These constants should not change depending on where it is included.
Seems consistent to provide a platform-specific `yield`, given a platform-specific `Thread` implementation is used.
